group.title: Hotel shuttle service
group.passage:
Maple Court Hotel — Station shuttle

Our complimentary shuttle operates between the hotel and East Station from 6:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. It leaves the hotel at 00 and 30 minutes past each hour and returns from the station at 15 and 45 minutes past.

Seats cannot be reserved. Please arrive at the pickup point ten minutes before departure. Large suitcases are accepted, but bicycles cannot be carried. Guests with mobility needs should contact reception one day ahead so that suitable assistance can be arranged.

On Sunday, roadworks will close the usual station entrance. The station pickup point will temporarily move to the north exit.
group.passageZh:
Maple Court Hotel——車站接駁服務

免費接駁車於上午六點半至晚上十點往返飯店與 East Station。每小時整點及三十分從飯店出發，每小時十五分及四十五分從車站返回。

座位無法預約。請在發車前十分鐘抵達乘車處。可攜帶大型行李箱，但不能載運自行車。需要行動協助的住客請提前一天聯絡櫃檯，以便安排適當協助。

星期日道路施工將封閉平時使用的車站入口，車站接駁乘車處將暫時移至北出口。
